title: RACI Layer Schema
description: Validates templates/<variant>/governance/raci.yaml. A generated, committed, drift-checked verification artifact that records Accountable, Responsible, Consulted, and Informed roles. See design §6.2 and ADR-0082.

variant.description: Variant identifier matching the template directory name.

generated_from.description: Source location from which this matrix was generated. Currently always 'procedures/'.

rows.description: RACI matrix rows, one per procedure activity.

stage.description: Stage identifier where this activity occurs. Resolves in process/stages.yaml.

accountable.description: Single agent (kebab-case) responsible for decisions and outcomes. Must equal the procedure's owner_agent. DEG-R-01 requires exactly one Accountable per activity.

responsible.description: Array of agents performing the work. Each resolves to a real agent file. DEG-R-02 requires at least one Responsible per activity.

consulted.description: Optional array of agents asked for input. Each resolves to a real agent file.

informed.description: Optional array of agents kept in the loop. Each resolves to a real agent file. DEG-R-03 forbids an agent from being both Accountable and Informed on the same activity.
